body.name: OpenAmika v1.1.1
body.body:
OpenAmika's **Use page** is new. Her controls sit on her stage, the page fits phones and tablets, and she loads much faster on the second visit. Most of this update is the work of RealDragonJT (#9). The hosted version runs at https://www.mekahime.com/amika.

### What's new

- **Controls on her stage**: power, microphone, camera, the text box, send and stop are in one bar at the bottom of her stage. A small chip at the top shows if she is offline, connecting, online or listening.
- **Transcript and Settings in one panel**: your conversation is under **Transcript**. Voice output, volume and your devices are under **Settings**.
- **Go big**: the expand menu at the top-right of her stage has **Fill window**, **Fullscreen** and **Desktop pet**. The conversation controls stay with her, and a drawer shows the transcript.
- **Desktop pet moved**: the button is now in that expand menu. Her desktop window takes over the microphone, the speaker and the voice setting from the page. If the microphone you picked is not connected, her window uses the system default and the page tells you. If **Voice output** is off, she asks before she moves.
- **Lock her position**: the lock stops an accidental drag or zoom. On a touch screen it also lets you scroll the page over her.
- **Phones and tablets**: the Use and Setup pages no longer scroll sideways on a phone, and the menu fits a tablet.
- **She loads faster**: your browser keeps her model files. A reload of the Use page downloads about 0.5 MB, not 27.5 MB. While she loads the first time, you see a loading sign and not an empty stage.
- **Your devices are remembered**: the microphone, the camera and the speaker you pick stay picked (the speaker where your browser supports it).
- **Camera preview**: move your own picture or fold it away without turning the camera off. On a phone that supports it, the rear camera's picture shows behind her.
- **Keyboard**: **W** Fill window, **F** Fullscreen, **L** lock, **M** microphone, **C** camera, **Esc** to leave. The keys do nothing while you type in a text box.
- **Unlock and Force wipe** no longer wait for a model that stopped answering.
- **Fixed**: in one rare failure the microphone stayed open while the button said "Mic off".
- **Languages**: a Korean README by am2rican5 (#10).

### Also in this update

- **Her "you're quiet" remark** waits until her voice has finished, also after she spoke first.
- **Tests**: 47 browser tests for the Use page run on every change, next to the 701 offline tests.

### Updating from v1.1.0

1. Stop her: double-click `Stop_OpenAmika.bat`.
2. Double-click `Update_OpenAmika.bat`. It saves her memory and your settings to a zip in `backups\`, downloads the update and installs what changed.
3. You see `Updated. Start her: double-click Start_OpenAmika.bat`.

Still on v1.0.0? Her folder has no `Update_OpenAmika.bat` yet. Do the three lines in the [v1.1.0 notes](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/releases/tag/v1.1.0) one time.

You downloaded the ZIP instead? Follow **I downloaded the ZIP** in [Updating her](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#updating-her-keeps-her-memory).

### Install

New here? Follow [Install her: 7 steps](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#install-her-7-steps) in the README, or watch them at https://www.mekahime.com/openamikatutorial. You need Windows 10 or 11, an NVIDIA RTX graphics card (20-series or newer, 8 GB of video memory) and about 40 GB of free disk.

### Licenses

OpenAmika's code is MIT. Amika herself is not MIT: her character, art, voice and Live2D model belong to MekaHime Inc. and are free under a personal-use license (personal use only, 18+, no redistribution or re-hosting, no training other models on them). Two creator rules cover social media and fan merch: read them in the README's [Licenses](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#licenses) section. The [LICENSE](https://huggingface.co/MekaHime/MekaHime_Amika/blob/main/LICENSE) on Hugging Face governs. Live2D Cubism Core keeps Live2D's own license.

Thank you to RealDragonJT and am2rican5 for their pull requests, and to everyone who reported a problem.

Report bugs at https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/issues, by email hi@mekahime.com, or on Discord https://discord.gg/mekahime · Support the project: https://www.mekahime.com/donate

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1

body.name: OpenAmika v1.1.0
body.body:
The first update of **OpenAmika**, built from what people told us in her first week on Discord and GitHub. She is easier to install, she updates without losing her memory, and she can stand on your desktop as a pet. The hosted version runs at https://www.mekahime.com/amika.

### What's new

- **Install her in 7 steps**: the README now starts with STEP 1 to STEP 7, with the exact line to paste in each. The same steps are a 3-minute video, with fixes and answers for when you get stuck: https://www.mekahime.com/openamikatutorial
- **Update her and keep her memory**: double-click `Update_OpenAmika.bat`. It saves her memory and your settings to a zip in `backups\`, downloads the update and installs what changed. Files you changed yourself stay yours.
- **Desktop pet mode**: she stands on your desktop in a see-through window, on top of your other programs, with her voice, lip-sync and expressions. Press **Desktop pet** on the Use page to move her there and back, or start her there with `Start_OpenAmika_Pet.bat`.
- **Setup**: it gives you the exact `cd` line when your window is in the wrong folder, asks for an optional Hugging Face token (faster downloads), continues a model download where it stopped, and accepts Python 3.12.
- **Starting her**: a port that Windows reserved (Hyper-V, WSL2, Docker Desktop) moves to the next free one by itself. A failed start keeps its window open and names the log. A red row says why that part did not start.
- **OpenRouter**: your balance shows next to your key, a model that OpenRouter no longer offers is named with a one-click way back, and a failed reply shows the provider's own reason in the chat.
- **Her voice**: she no longer spells CAPITALS letter by letter or reads "dot dot dot", and a dash is a pause.
- **Conversation**: her "you're quiet" remark counts from when her voice stops, and you choose Off, Rare or Normal (Setup → You & Amika). Spoken replies are shorter. She no longer answers twice when you press Stop.
- **Memory wipe and model switch**: no more "busy" with nothing running. New: **Force wipe**, **Unlock** and `launch.py --wipe-memory`. The backup is kept either way.
- **Asking for help**: `launch.py --diagnose` writes one zip to attach to a help request, with your keys cut out.
- **Text her**: clearer Discord hints (the bot must share a server with you before a DM works), and she names her own Discord channel instead of "here".
- **Smart home**: the optional IoT admin script no longer downloads a driver itself; Windows Update brings it (#2).
- **Languages**: a Vietnamese README by Huyvux12 (#3), and every console line is in English.

### Also since v1.0.0

- **Smart home safety statement**: you accept it before she can reach any device.
- **One-command setup**: `scripts\setup_windows.ps1` installs her brain, ears, memory and eyes, and a second run continues where the first stopped.
- **`launch.py --check`** also tests Ollama, another voice server on her port, her own running ports and the time-zone database.
- **Use page**: the prompt cache hit rate, per round and in total.
- **Which language model**: OpenRouter is recommended. A local Ollama model can take any of her brain roles; use one of 27B or more.
- **Her helpers**: she hands errands to Hermes Agent or nanoMuse, and a little paper doll at her desk shows what is being done for you.
- **Creator rules**: what you may do with Amika on social media and as fan merch is in the README's [Licenses](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#licenses).
- **READMEs**: a short one for people in English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese, and `README_IF_YOU_ARE_AI_AGENT.md` with everything about her for an AI coding agent.

### Updating from v1.0.0

Her folder has no `Update_OpenAmika.bat` yet, so the first update is three lines. It backs up her memory first.

1. Stop her: double-click `Stop_OpenAmika.bat`.
2. Open her folder. Right-click an empty spot → **Open in Terminal** (Windows 10: click the folder's address bar, type `powershell`, press **Enter**).
3. Paste each line and press **Enter**:

```powershell
git fetch origin
```

```powershell
git show origin/main:scripts/update_openamika.ps1 > scripts\update_once.ps1
```

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\update_once.ps1
```

You see `Updated. Start her: double-click Start_OpenAmika.bat`. From then on, double-click `Update_OpenAmika.bat`.

You downloaded the ZIP instead? Follow **I downloaded the ZIP** in [Updating her](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#updating-her-keeps-her-memory).

### Install

New here? Follow [Install her: 7 steps](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#install-her-7-steps) in the README, or watch them at https://www.mekahime.com/openamikatutorial. You need Windows 10 or 11, an NVIDIA RTX graphics card (20-series or newer, 8 GB of video memory) and about 40 GB of free disk.

### Licenses

OpenAmika's code is MIT. Amika herself is not MIT: her character, art, voice and Live2D model belong to MekaHime Inc. and are free under a personal-use license (personal use only, 18+, no redistribution or re-hosting, no training other models on them). Two creator rules cover social media and fan merch: read them in the README's [Licenses](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#licenses) section. The [LICENSE](https://huggingface.co/MekaHime/MekaHime_Amika/blob/main/LICENSE) on Hugging Face governs. Live2D Cubism Core keeps Live2D's own license.

Thank you to everyone who reported a problem or sent a pull request.

Report bugs at https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/issues, by email hi@mekahime.com, or on Discord https://discord.gg/mekahime · Support the project: https://www.mekahime.com/donate

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

body.name: OpenAmika v1.0.0
body.body:
The first open-source release of **Amika**, MekaHime's AI companion: a Live2D anime girl who talks with you by
voice and text in real time, remembers you, and lives with you in your city. It runs on your own Windows PC with
OpenRouter or fully local with Ollama. A hosted version runs at https://www.mekahime.com/amika.

### What's in it

- **Brain**: three prompt tiers (surface reflex, deep reply with inner thoughts, background reflection), an
  evidence-based long-term memory (BM25 + local bge-m3 embeddings), per-call cost metering, MCP tools.
- **Ears**: local SenseVoiceSmall speech recognition with voice activity detection and barge-in.
- **Voice**: the OpenAmika voice server (`vendor/tts-engine`, a MekaHime build of GPT-SoVITS) with 69 acted
  emotions; one emotion tag per sentence drives her voice, her face and her motion together.
- **Body**: Live2D stage; her own model downloads with her voice.
- **Pages**: Setup, Tools, Use (with a first-run wizard) and About, plus the architecture map at `/flow`.
- **Optional**: camera eyes (local VLM), smart home (Zigbee via MCP), Discord/Telegram "Text her".

### Install

Follow [Install (Windows)](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#install-windows) in the README. Her voice and her
Live2D model come from the Hugging Face repository
[MekaHime/MekaHime_Amika](https://huggingface.co/MekaHime/MekaHime_Amika): `envs\brain\python.exe
scripts\setup_tts.py` shows their license, asks you to type `yes`, and installs the voice server, upstream
GPT-SoVITS with its models, her voice and her model (about 5.5 GB of downloads; every file pinned by SHA-256).

### Licenses

OpenAmika's code is MIT. Amika's voice model, reference audio and Live2D model are © MekaHime Inc. under a
personal-use license: personal, non-commercial use only, 18+, no redistribution, no training other models on them,
visible credit to MekaHime when you post her. Live2D Cubism Core keeps Live2D's own license.

Report bugs at https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/issues, by email hi@mekahime.com, or on Discord
https://discord.gg/mekahime · Support the project: https://www.mekahime.com/donate
